notes.title: Spring 2016 Update & Post Mortem
notes.notes:
[h1] Update News[/h1]
A new Update for Revenge: Rhobar's myth is now live and brings a lot of great new additions to the game. The most improvements are technical aspects of the game. The mayor part of this update is the new level loading and hotreload system for the story. That means, that there is no more need to reload the entire world to switch from a day to a night version of the map or loading another mission. It's now done on the fly without the need of waiting on a loading screen.

This also allowed me to remove a lot of now unused assets and maps to save ~1GB of filesize. This also reduced the required amount of RAM, I was able to run the game the most time with the use of <2GB RAM, even with ne new and improved environmental lights and shadows.
Furthermore I reworked the start of the Story, I removed the very long intro sequence and rescripted the start of chapter 1. So it doesn't take that much time until you get into real gameplay. It is now also possible to change the time of day in the freeroam mode just by going to sleep. This will just take a few secondes and doen't require to reload the entire map.

[code]
>>> Changelog v30259 [30.03.2016]

|--- new Features ---|

+ new story start (get faster to real gameplay)
+ new story loading system (doesn't require to reload the entire world anymore)
+ ability to instantly change time of day (day / night) in freeroam by going to sleep

|--- Bugfixes ---|

- fixed navigation mesh

|--- additional changes ---|

- added new level streaming / loading mechanics
- enhanced environmental lights & shadow quality/distance
- removed unused assets & maps (reduced filesize by ~1GB)
[/code]

[h1] Future of Revenge: Rhobar's myth[/h1]
Right now I'm working with full power on a new game, bit this won't mean Revenge is dead. There are still some planned updates and features that will be released later this year. There is also a working prototype of Revenge 2 in Unreal Engine 4, but maybe 2017 is the year for a new Revenge … ;-)

[h1] Post Mortem [/h1]

[b] How it startet:[/b]
The Project started very simple, I dreamed about developing my own game – like almost every gamer tought about how great a own game would be. So I first started developing Mods for Half-Life 1 and then moved to learn Unreal Development Kit. The first steps was just modeling a small world to get used to the Editor – I recreated a very basic version of Hogwarts - [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TBPLsNHxYeg] Hogwarts 3D[/url]
Unit then I had absolutly no idea how to programm or develop a real game, I realized that developing a Shooter would be to much – so I started developing a First-Person Platformer → [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pl2IqSZMykc] Revenge of the Fallen	[/url]
After ~4-5 month of development I noticed the game isn't working greate, the game itself wasn't fun to play, the development wasn't that great. So I decided to rethink everything and came to the conclusion that  First-Person Platformer combinded with magic spells could be great. At this point, I knew a boit about programming and how the development worked and so Revenge: Rhobar's myth was born … https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LV4o3GeL8WQ

[b] What went right?:[/b]
I learned how to develop a game, to plan the work and learned to have a better view for importent things. It was a real great challenge to develop a open world game (even if the world is not that big) with absolutly no knowledge on how to start. Form the start of developing Revenge: Rhobar's myth I learned so much on how to use programs (Blender, Gimp, Unreal Editor, …), learned how to write working code and hardly learned what a missing design document and clear concept means…

[b] What went wrong?:[/b]
A lot :D The biggest problem was the missing design document and clear concept. I just didn't know what I was able to develop so the concept and design changed each weak that I learned more. At first it was just a linear jump 'n run with some magic spell elements that fast developed into and open world game with some small side quests and mini games. The feature list on the environment was growing and growing while the gameplay features haven't changed a lot over the time. I even added a full story with voiceover to cover the lack of gameplay – even if I knew I was terribly bad at writing.
The combination of enthusiasm, idealism and ignorance of mayor problems became a good but deadly friend. The scope of this project was just to big for a single person without experience and only 500$ of budget.

[b] Conclusion:[/b]
Revenge: Rhobar's myth was a great experience to learn how to develop a game. Now I know how to avoid chaos and how to organice the development. Now I know that less can sometimes be more. Revenge would have benefit from a more compressed content, shorter time to action and shorter idle times with just walking around. I still think Revenge is a great game and there are games that are a lot worse, even if some reviewers mentions the graphics of my game are very bad, I don't think so. I tink it's looking very great for 500$ budget and a singe person developing the game in 3D and not pixel look. But this is maybe like in real live. You love your child, no matter how ugly and annoying it is.
Revenge: Rhobar's myth is my baby and some words and reviews about scum really hurts for so much effort I put into this game...

I learned a lot out of my mistakes and I won't stop! None is born as a master in game development and I'm still learning :)
I moved to Unreal Engine 4 and we will see us soon again with a new, better and a lot different game … ;-)

notes.title: FINAL EARLY ACCESS UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers,

 it's time for a new update on the progress of Revenge: Rhobar's myth. You might have wondered why there wasn't any update/news the last weeks. The answer is very simple. I was working on a massive update that improves a lot parts of the game and will end the early access phase. The update comes with some new features, additions, fixes and improvements.

[b]Launcher:[/b]
- added Field of View (FOV) Slider in the range from 60 - 120
- added view distance selector (reducing the view distance can improve the performance up to 30%)
- added graphics preset selector

[b]Features:[/b]
- added new overview [url=http://d2oah9q9xdinv5.cloudfront.net/images/games/1/24/23343/1Map.png]map[/url] (toggled by pressing F1) 
- new respawn system (preventing to break story scripts)

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- reworked all story scripts to fix logic breaking bugs
- added new "target cams" in the story mode to easily find the mission target
- fixed various glitches and bugs- modified and added some trees

[b]Content:[/b]
- added several new quests and races

[b]Current status:[/b] 75% done
[b]Release date:[/b] When it's done

After this update the early access pahse ends and the price is set to 9,99€ / 13,99$.

[url=http://revenge-game.com/] Homepage	[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/PolygonArtStudios] Facebook	[/url]

notes.title: Performance Update v20931 is live!
notes.notes:
The first big update for Revenge is live! I worked very hard the last days and so I was able (depending on the settings) to reduze the required RAM by 1-2GB and the VRAM by 150-400MB.

I also changed the way the maps are loaded. Right now it's not that pretty. The important part is that it works better than the old way. Until now only some core maps are loaded. After that the screen will stay black for a short time until all other maps are streamed in. To give you the ability so see what's happening in the background I enabled the text based output on what is loaded.

[url=http://fs2.directupload.net/images/150517/fhlldgcj.jpg] It should look like this![/url] Not pretty bot you know what your PC is doing right now.

[h1]IMPORTANT[/h1]
Please remember that mobile GPUs, Intel HD GPUs or any GPUs with shared memory can cause problems. They are not supported!

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]
[code]>>> Changelog v20931 [17.05.2015]

|--- new Features ---|

+ new Map loading system
  + important maps are loaded directly, other will streamed while the screen is black
  + enable visibility of level streaming for debugging (will be removed later)
+ Launcher now detects 64 Bit OS and starts directly the 64 Bit version

|--- Bugfixes ---|

- fixed several collision bugs and glitches

|--- additional changes ---|

- reworked landscape distance streaming
- reworked tree distance culling
- removed grass meshes to reduce draw calls
- reworked all textures, added more detailed Texturegroups
- general perfomance improvements[/code]

notes.title: Solutions for crashes & upcoming performance update
notes.notes:
Hey gamers ;-)

you might have heard about some problems playing the game or you even had this problem for your self. I'm very sorry for that and I think it's time for a short explanation.

The most common reason why Revenge is crashing is the lack of RAM and/or VRAM. It's caused by the fact that a lot textures (including diffuse-, specular-, normal- and heightmap) are available in a resolution of 1024x1024.

[h1]How to fix the crashes:[/h1]

Lower the Texture & shadow quality, 'Ultra High' settings are for graphic cards with 2GB VRAM or more. The most useful fix is to [b]turn on the 64Bit mode[/b] (only if you are running on 64bit Windows version).
To turn on the 64Bit mode just open the launcher, click on Settings and right under FPS-Limit you need to check Force 64Bit. Enabling it solved the problems for the most people.

[h1]Performance update:[/h1]

Besides that I started working on a new update to improve the performance. And I made a great progress.

[i]Based on my system with a Intel Xeon E3.1231v3, Sapphire Radeon R290x Tri-X 4GB and 16 GB RAM on a 4k resolution with each settings on maximum (with constant 90FPS)	 in a worst case scenario[/i]
[b]RAM utilization:[/b]
Current version: 7,16GB
New Version:     5,43GB

[b]VRAM utilization:[/b]
Current version: 1315MB
New Version:     1130MB

[url=http://www11.pic-upload.de/09.05.15/k1regr3mboz.png] Utilization Screenshot old version[/url]
[url=http://www11.pic-upload.de/09.05.15/kf46vke9r6c.png] Utilization Screenshot new version	[/url]

As you can sea, if done a lot work and it should pay off. I'll need some days to improve all maps, expect the update at the end of the next week.

Thanks for your support and understanding!

notes.title: Release FAQ
notes.notes:
[b]When is the release on Steam?[/b]

7th May 2015

[b]Will it be released on Steam and Desura/IndieGameStand at the same time?[/b]

No! The reason is very simple. Updating/uploading on Steam is very easy and I expect a lot of feedback with the launch. On Desura/IndieGameStand I always need to upload full versions this would result into 3-5 new full versions within 2 weeks. I'll collect more updates to a bigger update for Desura and IndieGameStand.

Expect the Desura and IndieGameStand version in ~2 weeks.

[b]What is the difference between the Steam Version and all the other versions?[/b]

The versions are the same. Only if you run the game with a Steam account you'll have Steamworks features like Cloud Savegames, Achievements and Trading Cards.

[b]What about DRM?[/b]

There is no DRM. Also the Steam Version is DRM free and is able to run without Steam!

[b]What about DLCs?[/b]

There will be no DLCs in the 'classic' way. It's really classic – you will receive new content for free with updates!

[b]Can we expect new content each week, each month?[/b]

No! I have a lot of ideas for new content. There will be some new content while upgrading from Early Access to the final version. After that there will only be new content when it's done. 

Pressure only reduces the quality!

[b]I bought the game in a bundle, will I get a Steam key and if so when?[/b]

Yes you will reciev your Steam key! I want to release it step by step. First launch it on Steam an check if everything is really working great. If so a week later I'll start sending Steam keys to the Shops.

[b]System Requirements?[/b]

MINIMUM: 
OS: Win7 32-bit, Win8/8.1 32-bit 
Processor: Core 2 Duo E8200 2.66GHz or Phenom II X2 545 
Memory: 4 GB RAM 
Graphics: GeForce GTS 250 or Radeon HD 4830 (at least 1GB VRAM) 
DirectX: Version 9.0c 
Hard Drive: 4 GB available space 
Additional Notes: The game could run on Windows XP but is not tested! The requirements can change during development. The use of mobile GPUs can sometimes cause problems.

RECOMMENDED: 
OS: Win7 64-bit, Win8/8.1 64-bit 
Processor: Core 2 Quad Q9550 2.83GHz or Phenom II X4 955 
Memory: 6 GB RAM 
Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 or Radeon HD 6950 (at least 2GB VRAM or more) 
DirectX: Version 9.0c 
Hard Drive: 4 GB available space 
Additional Notes: The requirements can change during development. The use of mobile GPUs can sometimes cause problems.

[b]Important Informations:[/b]

The game uses a lot of high resolution textures and this results in the uncommon high requirements for RAM and VRAM. For Ultra High settings I would even recommend 8 GB RAM and a GPU with 3GB VRAM. Be sure your graphic card has 1GB dedicated VRAM

I'll collect more updates to a bigger update for Desura and IndieGameStand.

Expect the Desura and IndieGameStand version in ~2 weeks.

[b]What is the difference between the Steam Version and all the other versions?[/b]

The versions are the same. Only if you run the game with a Steam account you'll have Steamworks features like Cloud Savegames, Achievements and Trading Cards.

[b]What about DRM?[/b]

There is no DRM. Also the Steam Version is DRM free and is able to run without Steam!

[b]What about DLCs?[/b]

There will be no DLCs in the 'classic' way. It's really classic – you will receive new content for free with updates!

[b]Can we expect new content each week, each month?[/b]

No! I have a lot of ideas for new content. There will be some new content while upgrading from Early Access to the final version. After that there will only be new content when it's done. 

Pressure only reduces the quality!

[b]I bought the game in a bundle, will I get a Steam key and if so when?[/b]

Yes you will reciev your Steam key! I want to release it step by step. First launch it on Steam an check if everything is really working great. If so a week later I'll start sending Steam keys to the Shops.
